title: Field Registry Definition
description: Governed semantic contract defining what Facts referencing this permanent Field ID represent.

id.description: Permanent immutable registry identifier; never renamed, reassigned, or reused.

schema_version.description: Version of the Field Registry contract validating this definition.

canonical_name.description: Governed lowercase dotted name using an entity or shared namespace; it may be renamed without changing the Field ID.

display_label.description: Optional human-facing label; presentation metadata that is never used as an identifier.

description.description: Normative semantic meaning and interpretation of Facts governed by this Field.

applicable_entity_types.description: Entity collections on which this Field may be asserted.

value_type.description: Exact Fact value representation permitted for this Field.

allowed_units.description: Complete unit vocabulary permitted for numeric Facts; empty for non-numeric Fields.

unitless_policy.description: Whether numeric Facts require, allow, or prohibit the literal unitless unit; non-numeric Fields use not_applicable.

permitted_value_classifications.description: Production classifications permitted for Facts governed by this Field.

permitted_verification_states.description: Review states permitted for Facts governed by this Field.

cardinality.description: Whether the Field represents one or multiple concurrent assertions for one entity.

temporal_semantics.description: How observation and effective dates should be interpreted for this Field.

nullable_policy.description: Facts never encode unknown values as null; absence means no Fact exists.

estimated_values_allowed.description: Explicit permission to create estimated Facts for this Field.

derived_values_allowed.description: Explicit permission to create derived Facts for this Field.

multiple_active_facts_allowed.description: Whether more than one active Fact may exist for the same entity and Field.

default_confidence_policy.description: Optional Field-specific confidence guidance; null applies the repository-wide policy.

semantic_categories.description: Controlled semantic and lifecycle categories used for discovery and governance.

deprecated.description: Whether this Field is closed to new active Facts while remaining valid for historical records.

replacement_field_id.description: Direct governed replacement for a deprecated Field; null for active Fields.

documentation_notes.description: Optional governance clarification, examples, or interpretation boundaries.

created_at.description: UTC date-time when the permanent Field ID was registered.

modified_at.description: UTC date-time of the latest governed metadata revision; the Field ID remains unchanged.
